notes:
Inbound from integration with a mid-market helpdesk tool vendor. Lead found us through content piece on cost-aware batching.

Quick summary: SMB support automation startup building an AI layer to generate ticket summaries, call downstream tool APIs (e.g., create/update tickets, add tags), and emit structured JSON for backend orchestration. Primary objective is to reduce agent handling time and automate 40% of triage.

What they told us (verbatim / paraphrase):
- "Want something we can try without enterprise contracts — self-serve hosted API is ideal."
- "Need predictable per-ticket costs; spikes tied to ticket surges are a big concern."

Key technical constraints / preferences:
- Prefer public cloud + simple API keys for initial PoC; may explore VPC later if enterprise customers demand it.
- Workloads: batch nightly summarization (bulk), streaming tool-calling for live agent assist, structured output schema (JSON) for ticket fields.
- Latency targets: interactive tool-calling <500ms median for agent assist; background summarization can be higher (1-3s).
- Throughput: expect bursts up to ~300 qps during peak routing events; typical steady-state ~30 qps.
- Cost sensitivity: high. Target <$0.008 per completed ticket on bulk summarization pipeline if possible.
- Model preference: open model family preferred; willing to test quantized variants. Looking for Redwood model catalog guidance.

Security / compliance notes:
- SSO (SAML) required for admin console.
- Need proof of SOC2 or SOC2-aligned practices for security team.
- Data residency: US (primary).
- Audit logs and retention controls required for troubleshooting and compliance.

Timeline & recent activity:
- 2026-03-01: initial inbound signup (self-serve trial) — created sandbox account, provided quickstart.
- 2026-03-03: discovery call (Maya + Carlos) — 30m. Fireflies attached (ff_2026-03-03_caseclutch_call_87b9).
- 2026-03-05: submitted sample dataset (ticket_export_10k.csv) to SE for cost/latency estimates.
- 2026-03-09: SE ran cost projection on batch summarization (rough): $6k/month at current volumes (needs optimization).
- 2026-03-12: security team emailed (see gmail thread gt_20260303_3245-thread) asking for SOC2 evidence and DPA draft.

POC plan proposed:
- Week 0-1: trial hosted_api keys, ingest sample tickets, run baseline summarization with open-weights model; measure latency/cost.
- Week 2: implement structured output schema + tool-calling flow (create ticket, add tags, run reranking).
- Week 3: run 48-hour spike test with synthetic bursts to validate autoscaling and per-request latency.
